artworks.title: Abraham Ortelius (Wortels)
artworks.description: The image shows a bust-length profile portrait of a man facing right. He has a prominent nose, high forehead, receding hairline, short hair, neatly trimmed beard, serious expression, deep-set eyes, and defined brow. He wears a richly detailed outfit with a high collar, fur trim, and buttons. The portrait is surrounded by an elaborate border with ornate scrollwork, floral motifs, and decorative elements. In the center top is a circular medallion with Greek letters, and similar motifs are around the oval portrait frame. The background is filled with ornamental design, and at the bottom, there is an inscribed ribbon with Latin text.

artworks.title: Abraham Ortelius (Wortels)
artworks.description: The image shows a colored portrait of a man in a bust view, facing to the right. He has a bald head with gray hair around the sides, a beard, pointed nose, and high cheekbones. He wears an ornate outfit with a white ruffled collar, a black undergarment, and a red outer garment trimmed with brown fur. There are black embellishments on his sleeve. The portrait is in an elaborate frame with floral and scroll motifs in red, gold, blue, and green. The frame includes a round emblem with the letters "IHS" or a similar symbol at the top. A Latin inscription is below the oval frame. The background is off-white paper, slightly discolored with age at the corners.

artworks.title: Title Page to Abraham Ortelius, Theatrum Orbis Tenarum
artworks.description: This is a painting of an ornate memorial plaque. It features an elaborately designed architectural structure resembling a classical facade adorned with Corinthian columns with acanthus leaf capitals. The central portion contains a Latin inscription dedicated to Abraham Ortelius, surrounded by a stone-like framework with decorative pilasters and entablatures. Above the inscription, there is a round portrait medallion of a man with a beard and ruffled collar, topped by a figure of a man wielding a staff with a banner. The left and right sides of the structure are flanked by classical figures, one holding a shovel and the other with a globe. The bottom part features a smaller circular medallion displaying a globe, embellished with ornamental scrollwork.

artworks.title: Otto Henry, Count of Schwarzenberg
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man depicted from the waist up. He is sitting and facing slightly to his right, with a three-quarter view of his body. His facial features include a beard and mustache, and his hair is wavy and short. He wears a high, elaborate ruffled collar that frames his face, and his clothing consists of a richly textured coat adorned with fur trimming. His left hand is extended with fingers partially open, and his right hand rests on a book or document on the table in front of him. There is a globe and a skull on the table as well. The background features draped fabrics.

artworks.title: Sir Thomas Overbury
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of Sir Thomas Overbury. He is depicted from the waist up, seated at a desk with his head resting on his left hand and gaze directed towards the viewer. He has curly hair, closely cropped, and features a slightly upturned mustache. He wears a richly embroidered garment with a ruffled collar, typical of early 17th-century fashion. His right hand holds a quill over a partially open paper. A small inkpot is to his left. Above and to the right of the portrait is a coat of arms, and to the left is a decorative scroll identifying him. The background is ornately decorated with patterns and flourishes.

artworks.title: Count Axel Gustafsson Oxenstiern, Chancellor of Sweden
artworks.description: The image features an engraved portrait of an older man with a receding hairline and shoulder-length wavy hair, a full beard, and mustache. He is shown from the waist up in a three-quarter view, looking towards the viewer. The man wears a historical garment with an ornate lace collar, a dark cloak, and holds a rolled document or parchment. Behind him is a draped curtain tied back with a tassel, partially revealing an outdoor scene with smoky plumes. The oval frame's background is dark, and the image is bordered by text in an older style of engraving.

artworks.title: Francis Paget, Jesuit Priest
artworks.description: The image shows a torso-length illustration of a person facing slightly to the left, with a high-collared garment and a large cloak draped over their shoulders. The person has short hair, a trimmed beard, and holds a large quill or staff. To the left, an angelic figure is shown holding a leafy branch and flying amidst clouds. The background includes a faint depiction of hills, a small building, and the foreground has Latin text framed by a border.

artworks.title: Bernard Paluden
artworks.description: The image displays an upper-body portrait of a man facing forward. He has a flower in his right hand, a lined face, a beard, a mustache, a cap, formal clothing with a large ruffled collar, a furry garment on his shoulders, and a medallion on a chain around his neck. The background is plain with engraved lines, giving the portrait a textured look.

artworks.title: Ambrosius Parens
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a man facing slightly to the right. He has distinct facial features, with a high forehead, deep-set eyes, short beard, and mustache. The man has short, thinning hair and is wearing a high-collared ruffled shirt under a textured, buttoned garment. The outfit includes decorative elements and buttons on the sleeve. There are inscriptions to the left and upper right corners of the portrait.

artworks.title: Ambrosius Parens
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man with a solemn expression. He has deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and a long beard. His hair is short and thin, with a receded hairline. He is wearing an ornate collared garment with a ruffled collar, buttons down the front, and decorative elements on the shoulders and sleeves. There is text at the top of the background and his name, "AMBROSIVS PAREVS," displayed below the image.

artworks.title: Matthew Parker, Archbishop of Canterbury
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated individual holding a book, wearing a robe and a cap. The person has a stern facial expression, with short hair visible. The background features a cross-hatched pattern, and there is text at the bottom of the portrait.

artworks.title: Matthew Parker, Archbishop of Canterbury
artworks.description: The image depicts a man's upper body, focusing on his head and shoulders. He is seated upright and looking directly forward. His facial features are distinct, with intense eyes, a prominent nose, and a mustache. He is wearing a snug cap covering his hair, a formal robe with a high collar, and a scarf-like garment around his shoulders. There are no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The background features an oval frame with text around the edges, set against a lightly speckled plain backdrop.

artworks.title: Robert Parsons, Jesuit Missionary
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man's upper body, focusing on his head and shoulders. The man faces forward with a slight turn to the right. His facial features include a long face, a prominent nose, and a beard. He wears a large cap typical of certain historical clergy, and his hair is neatly groomed. The man wears a robe-like garment and there are no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The background has horizontal lines and the engraving includes text at the bottom stating: "P. ROBERTVS PERSONIVS Eerste Missionaris van de Societeyt in Engelandt."

artworks.title: Robert Parsons, Jesuit Missionary
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper body of a person, depicted from the chest upwards. The person is positioned facing slightly to the left but looking straight at the viewer. He has a solemn facial expression with defined features. His hair is not visible, as he is wearing a cap that fits closely to his head and extends upward with a flat, triangular shape. He is dressed in a religious garment with a high collar and a cloak. The background is plain and features an oval emblem with the letters "IHS" and a cross. The portrait is surrounded by a border with Latin text at the bottom identifying the individual as "P. Robertus Personius Socivs et Svpprior P. Campiani in Prima Missione Anglicana."

artworks.title: P. Robertus Personius, Priest
artworks.description: The image is a framed engraving showing a bust of a man in three-quarter view. His face has distinguished facial features, such as deep-set eyes with heavy eyelids, a prominent nose, and a well-defined mouth. He has a neatly trimmed beard and short hair mostly covered by a distinctive cap. The cap is tall, rounded, and slightly pleated, indicating a clerical or religious attire. He is wearing a simple, dark robe with a high collar. The background is plain with vertical lines. To the upper left, there is an emblem with "IHS," a cross, and three nails surrounded by radiant lines. Below the image, there is an inscription displaying the name "P. Robertus Personius Socivs et Svperior."

artworks.title: Stephen Paschasius
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of an elderly man with a prominent nose, deeply set eyes, and a full beard. He is wearing a cap, a coat with a wide collar, and a tunic with vertical pleats. In the background is an oval frame with the words "STEPH PASCHASIVS REGIARVM PATRONVS" around it. The oval has cross-hatching inside and etched patterns outside. At the bottom, there is a decorative scroll with a textual inscription.

artworks.title: Magdalen de Pass
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a woman from the chest up. She is facing forward, with her head slightly turned to the left, looking directly at the viewer. The woman has delicate features including a rounded face, a proportional nose, and pursed lips. Her hair is covered by a hood that fits snugly around the back of her head. She is wearing an elaborate ruffled collar typical of the early modern period fashion. The clothing is richly textured, featuring dark fabric with visible patterns on the upper garment. There are no visible accessories or objects in her hands. The background is plain, emphasizing the figure in the portrait.

artworks.title: Gabrielle Charlotte Patin
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a woman depicted from the waist up. She is positioned slightly turned to her left, with her hands resting on a table where flowers are laid. Her facial features include a delicate face with a calm expression and her hair is styled in an elaborate manner with curls framing her face. She is wearing a dress with intricate detailing, including lace and decorative elements, and a necklace adorns her neck. In the background, there is a window with a peacock visible outside. The elaborate border surrounding the portrait is filled with swirling designs and scriptwork, providing a formal and intricate frame to the central oval image.

artworks.title: Georg Paul Jenisch
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up seated with his body facing right, holding a book in his right hand on a stand. He has a stern facial expression and is looking directly at the viewer. His hair is shoulder-length, wavy, brown, and he has a mustache and a small goatee. He is wearing a dark robe with a white ruff collar typical of 17th-century fashion. The background is a dark texture that emphasizes the subject. A border surrounds the image with script at the bottom indicating the man’s name and likely some biographical information.

artworks.title: Mary Sidney, Countess of Pembroke
artworks.artist: Burnet Reading after Simon de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person's upper half. The individual faces slightly to the right, holding an open book in front of their chest with both hands. They have an oval-shaped face, fine features, and a serious expression. Their hair is styled in tight curls framing the face. The person wears an elaborate gown with intricate lace details at the neck and shoulders. Strands of pearls or jeweled necklaces are around their neck, and they wear matching earrings. The background is plain and dark.

artworks.title: Mary Sidney, Countess of Pembroke
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait showing the upper half of a woman facing forward. The woman has a round face with tightly curled hair framing her face. She wears an ornate, lace-trimmed collar, a double-strand pearl necklace, and earrings. Her outfit has an intricate design, indicating richness and skilled craftsmanship. She holds a closed book labeled "DAVID Psalmes" in her left hand. The portrait is enclosed within a decorative oval frame with Latin inscriptions, a crown, and scrolls at the corners. Behind her is an elaborate etched background.

artworks.title: Mary Sidney, Countess of Pembroke
artworks.description: The image features a historical portrait of a woman from the waist up. She is seated, facing forward with her body slightly angled to the left. Her facial expression is calm and composed, with distinct features including wide eyes and a serene mouth. Her hair is styled in a voluminous, curly fashion typical of the era, framing her face elegantly. She is adorned in richly detailed clothing, featuring intricate patterns and luxurious lace ruffles around the neck and sleeves. The woman is wearing a pearl necklace and matching pearl drop earrings, holding a small open book in her hand that shows the text "David Psalma". The background of the image is an ornate oval frame with scrollwork and decorative elements. Text in Latin and English provides context about the individual depicted, identified as Lady Mary Sidney.

artworks.title: Mary Sidney, Countess of Pembroke
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a woman depicted from the waist up. She is positioned facing forward with her head slightly turned to the left. She has a serene expression, large almond-shaped eyes, a straight nose, and full lips. Her hair is styled in a tight coil of curls and adorned with flowers on one side. She wears a detailed garment with puffed sleeves, a draped neckline, and a broach at the center. Around her neck is a double-strand necklace with a pendant. The scene is enclosed within an oval frame surrounded by ornate scrollwork and decorative elements, including a crown motif emblem at the top. The background features intricate linework and ornamental details, including Latin inscriptions around the oval and French text at the bottom.

artworks.title: William Herbert, First Earl of Pembroke
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the chest up, facing slightly to his left. He has a prominent jawline, a pointed mustache, and a neatly trimmed beard. His hair is styled back under a cap with a feather plume. The man wears a high-collared garment with a ruffled lace collar and buttons down the center. A necklace with an oval medallion hangs around his neck. The background is plain and dark, and the oval frame around the portrait includes text around the edges.
